newsitem.title: UK: Iraq tenders for up to six cargoes of sugar - trade.
newsitem.headline: Iraq tenders for up to six cargoes of sugar - trade.

text.p: Iraq is seeking to buy between four and six cargoes of lower-quality 100 ICUMSA white sugar for arrival between mid-February and early March, European sugar traders said on Monday. The tender is to be held on December 17, they said. "Part of it is for arrival February 15 and part of it is arrival March 7," said one.

Iraq is expected to issue a series of tenders to buy commodities, including wheat, rice and sugar, over a six-month period when it will be selling oil in exchange for food under a $2 billion deal approved by the U.N.
Jordanian traders have said Iraq could import some 300,000 tonnes of sugar during this period.
But Iraq is likely to proceed slowly with its sugar tenders and gauge the mood of the world market before buying more.
"I think they want to book this one first," the trader said. -- Jeremy Smith, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
